top_findings.title: Factual gate FAILS: 2019 Série A standings are numerically wrong (factual_accuracy=0.0)
top_findings.evidence: _factual.json: Flamengo row [55,37,11,7,...] vs expected 28W-6D-4L/38 played/90 pts. Root cause R5: factual_accuracy.py:267 calls get_standings competition='serie-a' first; mcp-server.ts:214 -> getStandings(2019,'serie-a') (soccer-service.ts:216-217) aggregates Brasileirao+Libertadores+Copa do Brasil. data-loader.ts:154-185 mergeMatches DOES dedupe, so doubling is the R5 collapse, not CSV concatenation.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix R5; getStandings(2019,'Brasileirão Série A') already yields the correct 38-game table.

top_findings.title: Competition filter collapses to match-everything for the 'Série A' aliases
top_findings.evidence: src/normalize.ts:97-103 competitionKey() strips 'serie a'/'campeonato'/'copa' so competitionKey('serie-a')=''. src/normalize.ts:145-149 matchesCompetition() returns left.includes('')==true for every match. Filter IS present and correct for Libertadores/Copa do Brasil/Brasileirao/'Brasileirão Série A' -> partial, not missing.
top_findings.suggestion: Map aliases to a canonical token and require left===right (or guard empty right).
